title: Kitchen and Tide
author: Kestrel Halloran
blurb: Emrys Dravenmoor, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the festival ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
